caption: [character1], an expressive investigative journalist, with olive skin and short-cropped dark hair in a beige linen blazer, and [character2], a spirited local vendor, with weathered features and a braided grey beard in a vibrant silk scarf, fanning steam from a kettle toward camera and laughing, positioned center-frame in a tilted medium two-shot, a bustling night market under high noon sun with gentle snowfall and sharp shadows, Dutch angle tilt, handheld perspective, shallow depth of field, ensuring both faces are front-facing and clearly visible.
